name: github-desktop-plus
description: External enhancement tool for GitHub Desktop — Rust runtime + 0-path Electron hooks

scripts.build: tsx scripts/wsl-agent.ts && tsx scripts/locales.ts prepare zh-CN && pnpm -r --if-present run build && cargo build --workspace --release
scripts.check: pnpm run version:check && tsx scripts/locales.ts prepare zh-CN && pnpm -r --if-present run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run test && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace && cargo test --workspace
scripts.self-check:desktop: tsx scripts/locales.ts prepare zh-CN && pnpm -r --if-present run build && tsx scripts/checks/desktop.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsx scripts/checks/no-js.ts && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
